name: Bug-hunt fixes: CRLF edits, MCP spawn on Windows, non-blocking /mcp, /reload under cargo install
description: Four findings from the rusti-bughunt-s1 report. F6: edit_file/multi_edit matched old_text byte-for-byte, so an LF old_text never matched a CRLF file (git autocrlf on Windows); when the exact text is absent from a CRLF file, multi_edit now matches old with CRLF line breaks and writes new with CRLF, so the file keeps its endings. F7: every MCP server ran as `cmd /C <command> <args>` on Windows, so `&`, `|`, `%VAR%` in arguments were re-parsed by cmd; mcp::build now resolves a bare command on PATH (.com/.exe/.bat/.cmd) and spawns it directly, and std escapes the arguments when the target is a .cmd/.bat shim. F8: Enter on an /mcp row ran set_enabled (up to three 60 s handshake waits) on the UI thread; toggle_mcp now shows 'connecting…'/'switching off…' and runs it on a spawned thread whose result is a Notice that also refreshes the open /mcp list; set_enabled re-checks config and the registry before registering, so a server toggled again mid-handshake is neither kept nor duplicated. F12: /reload treated any MANIFEST_DIR with a Cargo.toml as a source checkout, but `cargo install --git` keeps its build dir in cargo's checkout cache; a manifest dir with cargo's `.cargo-ok` marker (git checkouts and registry sources both have it) now takes the installed-binary restart path.
evidence: Regression tests from the report's repros: ai_core::tools::tests::edit_matches_lf_old_text_in_a_crlf_file (CRLF file, LF old/new -> edited, CRLF kept); ai_core::mcp::tests::shim_args_reach_the_server_unchanged (Windows: bare name -> .cmd on PATH; DSN with '&' echoed whole, empty stderr); tui::app::tests::mcp_toggle_does_not_wait_for_the_handshake (server = `sort`, which never answers: toggle returns in under 5 s with 'connecting…'); tui::tests::reload_from_a_cargo_install_checkout_relaunches_current_exe (Cargo.toml + .cargo-ok -> current_exe, one notice, no cargo). cargo test 129 pass (unit + rpc + trust), ./init.sh passes, cargo clippy --all-targets adds no warnings in the changed lines. Cargo's markers checked on disk: ~/.cargo/git/checkouts/rusti-*/<rev>/ has .git and .cargo-ok; registry/src/*/<crate>/ has .cargo-ok.
decisions: F6 converts only when the exact old_text is not found, so an edit that already matches (LF file, or CRLF old_text) behaves as before; the diff shown to the model keeps the LF text.

F7 resolves only the extensions CreateProcess can start; a PATHEXT .js/.py command needs a file association, so it is not supported bare (write `node x.js`). A command that resolves to nothing is left for std to report.
F8 uses a plain thread per toggle rather than a Job on the agent thread, which is busy for the whole of a running turn.
F12 marks cargo's cache by `.cargo-ok` instead of requiring a .git dir: cargo's git checkouts contain .git too, and a source tarball should still rebuild.
